description: This file defines the 'Continue' class, which implements a method operation for handling the <continue> element in the MiniLang language used within the OFBiz framework. It includes logic to throw a custom exception to handle the 'continue' operation during script execution, as well as a factory class for creating instances of 'Continue'.

classes.name: Continue
classes.description: Represents the <continue> element in MiniLang; throws an exception to continue the loop.

classes.name: Continue.ContinueElementException
classes.description: Custom exception thrown when a <continue> element is encountered outside a loop.

classes.name: Continue.ContinueFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating Continue instances.

methods.name: Continue(Element element, SimpleMethod simpleMethod)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Continue object with XML element and method context.

methods.name: exec(MethodContext methodContext)
methods.description: Executes the operation, which throws the ContinueElementException.

methods.name: toString()
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the <continue/> element.

methods.name: getMessage()
methods.description: Provides detailed message information for the ContinueElementException.

methods.name: createMethodOperation(Element element, SimpleMethod simpleMethod)
methods.description: Factory method to create a Continue object.

methods.name: getName()
methods.description: Returns the string 'continue', the name of the operation.
